definitions.gloss: a glance, a glimpse, a brief look
definitions.explanation: A quick, brief look at something or someone. Often implies a dismissive or casual glance, or a swift survey of a situation.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{書類|しょるい}→書類：01103_shorui⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{一瞥|いちべつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦くれた→くれる：00724_kureru⟧。
examples.english: He gave the documents a quick glance.

examples.japanese: {一瞥|いちべつ}⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧で、⟦{興味|きょうみ}→興味：01316_kyoumi⟧なさそう⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{立|た}ち{去|さ}った→立ち去る：04640_tachisaru⟧。
examples.english: After just a glance, she walked away looking uninterested.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部屋|へや}→部屋：00507_heya⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{一瞥|いちべつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{何|なに}か→何か：03873_nanika⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{変|か}わっている→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧こと⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{気|き}づいた。
examples.english: When I glanced around the room, I noticed something had changed.

notes:
USAGE:
A literary or formal word for a brief look. Often implies that the glance is quick and possibly dismissive. Common in written narrative and formal speech. Can be used with ⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to glance) or ⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧/⟦{与|あた}える→与える：01821_ataeru⟧ (to give a glance).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {一瞥|いちべつ}⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to glance at)
- {一瞥|いちべつ}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦くれる→くれる：00724_kureru⟧ (to give a glance)
- {一瞥|いちべつ}もしない (to not even glance at)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ちらっ⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{見|み}る→見る：00283_miru⟧: to glance — casual, everyday expression
- {一瞥|いちべつ}: a glance — more literary and formal
